caption: The drawing features a single, large, green glass bottle with a narrow neck and a wide, rounded, teardrop-shaped body tapering to a point at the base. The surface of the bottle is overlaid with an intersecting diamond grid pattern, which gives a textured appearance. The bottle is drawn within a faint square border centered on a cream-colored paper background. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified outline sketch of the same bottle enclosed within its own small square. The outline sketch shows the same body shape and grid pattern as the main bottle but without color. The artist's name "JANET RIZA" is printed in small capital letters at the bottom right corner of the main square.
title: Flask
